sources.open_images: Open Images V4-V6 validation split: images CC BY 2.0 as listed by Google (per-image author and landing page below); human-verified boxes and image labels CC BY 4.0. Photos are fetched by id and never committed.
sources.synthetic: Owned worksheets rendered by scripts/jana_tools/person_calibration.py (LicenseRef-Own); fonts listed with hashes.

labels.person: Open Images validation photo with at least one human-verified, non-depiction Person/Man/Woman/Boy/Girl/Human face box; stratum by the largest such box's share of the frame.
labels.no_person: Photographed page (text, handwriting, chart, plan, board) with no human box or human image label in Open Images, then reviewed by eye: review = page. Candidates showing objects, screens, or any depiction of a person (banknote portraits, pictograms, cartoons) are excluded.

reviewers: Claude Code implementation session, 2026-10-23 (page review by eye); independent review pending
